cases.surface_condition: left ends with a short PP (prep + ≤3 tokens) ending in directional noun; right starts with determiner+noun
cases.blamed_rule: closing punctuation token attached to the previous word
cases.proposed_rule: Re-anchor short-PP cases: if left is prep+≤3 tokens ending in directional noun, cap to Middle (40–60).

cases.surface_condition: right begins with a subordinating conjunction (if/when/because/although) immediately after the marker
cases.blamed_rule: Left ends in 'that', 'which', 'who', or a subordinating signal
cases.proposed_rule: Sharpen subordinator enforcement: if right begins with subordinator, cap to Low (≤20) unless explicit clause-closer punctuation precedes marker.

cases.surface_condition: left ends with common-noun title; right begins with a single capitalized token (proper name/apposition)
cases.proposed_rule: Re-anchor capitalized-name splits: when right is single capitalized token after noun-title, cap to Middle (40–60).

cases.surface_condition: right begins with restricting adverb ('only','just') immediately followed by a preposition or numeral
cases.blamed_rule: The remainder begins with a few words that could change polarity, participant identity, scope, or referent of the left
cases.proposed_rule: Sharpen restricting-adverb rule: immediate right 'only'/'just' + (prep|number) → floor to Low (0–20).

calibration_fix: Raise 00–09 anchor to 20–29; reserve 0–9 only for unmistakable fragments.
summary: Model over-scores where surface cues mimic clause boundaries (commas, capitals, short PPs). Tighten and re-anchor those specific cues to lower bands.
